# Acquisition fixtures

Stage 5 tests generate their PCM16 WAV input from original sine-wave samples at
runtime. No recording, lyric, remote URL response, or third-party media is
stored in this directory.

The generated bytes are covered by the repository license and are authorized
for redistribution. Network-boundary tests use deterministic injected
transports and resolver answers; they never contact the public internet or a
local network service.
